candidates.change_summary: Change the require condition from 'msg.sender == Owner' to 'msg.sender != Owner'.
Change the transfer recipient from Owner to msg.sender.
Delete the require statement, making the function accessible to anyone.
Remove the Owner requirement so any caller can execute Command.
Delete the require statement, removing Owner check.
Replace Owner with address(0) in the require, making Owner check always fail.
Delete the low-level call, making Command a no-op that accepts ETH.
Replace the low-level call with call to address(0) so ETH is burned and call always fails (changing the call result).
Replace msg.value with 0 in the call value, changing the forwarded ETH.
Delete the call value option so no ETH is forwarded.
Replace `require(((address(this).balance + msg.value) >= address(this).balance))` with `require(false)` to always revert.
Replace `if(msg.value>=address(this).balance)` condition with `if(true)` to bypass the value check.
Replace `require(((address(this).balance + msg.value) >= address(this).balance))` with `require((address(this).balance >= address(this).balance))` to change the overflow check condition.
Remove the `require` statement so the transfer can occur without the overflow check.
Replace `payable(adr).transfer(address(this).balance+msg.value)` with `payable(Owner).transfer(address(this).balance+msg.value)` to send the funds to the Owner instead of the parameter address.
